svg.title: GONE | Transverse ship section, proposed beam and thirty decks
svg.desc: Broad faceted hull cut looking along X. Horizontal is lateral Z, vertical is deck height Y. Thirty individual deck rows span ten parallel neighborhoods with five vertical shafts and cross aisles. A local seven-pod start bay and secondary power marker share one opening deck; their built X separation is shown in a top-down inset. One isolated outboard scar is proposed. Dimensions and deck placements are proposals, not measured exterior geometry.
svg.text: +X into page / proposed hull, not measured exterior
ILLUSTRATIVE BEAM ~450 m (proposal; bible sets no width)
Same built deck (D14 row shown only as placement proposal). X positions differ; see inset.
Five proposed shafts stay inside the pressure shell. Cross-aisles and paired return links are schematic, not playable routes.
Drives are aft along X; this section does not place them here.
Built opening anchor: bay and secondary power, same deck
Named story functions: berths, stasis, services, engineering
Proposed neighborhood cells, corridors and shafts
One proposed local scar; X location unspecified
This cut may miss a second scar at another X. Remaining pressure hull,
keel and access around the isolated bay remain intact in this proposal.
+X right toward corridor endcap / +Z up / +Y up out of page / 22 px = 1 local meter
Built floor-plan meters. Inset is not to scale with the ship-wide section above.
Design reference only. D01–D30, exact opening deck, beam, depth, structures and local damage placement are proposals, not bible measurements.
